## Contract

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `archseal doctor` passes
- [ ] `archseal check` passes
- [ ] CLI or policy compatibility impact is documented
- [ ] Security / trust-boundary impact was considered

## Why

Describe the invariant or failure mode this change addresses.

## Evidence

Include the smallest reproducible example, test, benchmark, or CI evidence needed to review the change.
